annotations.title: Upload an in-app product's review screenshot

description: Uploads the screenshot App Review looks at for one App Store product (PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB, from an absolute path on this machine): the screen where it's bought in the app. It replaces the one there. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
